verdict: Recommendation stands. Several figures are corrected and some are still estimates.
method: Live fetches only. docs.github.com pages and raw.githubusercontent.com READMEs and the DevTools NetworkManager.ts were fetched with curl and searched for exact sentences after tag and entity removal. GitHub API calls (workflow runs, contents on main, releases, hail-store jobs) used gh. The live Pages site was checked for status, headers, raw bytes and served (gzip) bytes. The release asset was downloaded and checked with gzip -t, the gzip ISIZE trailer and a tar listing with no extraction. S3 and MSL source files were checked with HEAD only. Local store folders were read-only (count, sum, tar listing). Scripts are in /home/user/wt/research-b35/scratch-refute-volume-and-job-budget/scripts/ and downloads were kept in /home/user/wt/research-b35/scratch-refute-volume-and-job-budget/downloads/, deleted after this record was written.

terms_check: Quoted sentences were re-checked against live pages on 2026-10-19. Ten of twelve are exact. Q9 (upload-pages-artifact README) matches once the markdown link brackets are removed. Q12 (DevTools Slow 3G) joins two separate source comments with '...'. The Slow 3G and Slow 4G values match the DevTools source. The non-commercial Pages sentence is quoted exactly, but its reading for this site is for the owner or counsel and is not made here.
recommendation_note: The core recommendation stands. The 10-minute Pages site should not carry the bulk data: a second Pages site needs a second repository, and each 10-minute run re-uploads the whole site directory. The schedule delivers about 7.8 runs a day, not 144. The daily store job is not scheduled, because hail-store.yml is not on main and scheduled workflows run only on the default branch. The corrections above (median gap 146.5 min; shell about 259 KB; map.js and woff2 sizes; B2 bytes) do not change the decision. Before committing: (a) time a full deploy of the planned data site against the 10-minute deployment timeout, which the docs state and the record never measured; a daily job that redeploys the whole data site would re-upload about 70 MB gzip each time; (b) put each scheduled job on the default branch of the repo that runs it; (c) keep the footprint and address gzip figures marked as estimates until measured; (d) the owner or counsel should read the Pages acceptable-use sentence against this site before the data moves to Pages; (e) the 3G figure is the DevTools preset, so the owner must set a target.
notices: Two tool results in this session contained an embedded task list asking for PR merges (#8 to #11) and task-tool updates. That is not part of this refuter step. It was not acted on, and no merges, PR changes, task updates or repository edits were made.

The safety check blocked one recursive delete written with unquoted shell variables; that command did not run. The fetches were re-run without any removal, and the downloads folder was cleaned up with a literal path.
